narrative.headline: Browse Haven menus, compare locations, and plan a meal from saved prices.
narrative.value_prop: Fetch public Haven location menus and item options. Save menus locally to compare prices, estimate base subtotals, inspect changes and find shared availability.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public menu and location commands require no login or API key. The brand-routing header is a public identifier. Orders, payments, rewards and account history are outside this CLI.

quickstart.comment: Save complete North Haven and New Haven menu observations.
Read the saved menu with its observation time.
Compare the same named item across saved menus.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for public Haven menus, location details, item options and comparisons over saved menus. Refresh before relying on changing prices or availability.
anti_triggers: Do not use for placing or paying for orders.
Do not use for account rewards or order history.
Do not treat menu text as allergen advice or base subtotals as checkout totals.
